fusions.name: Plucked Note
fusions.desc: Plucks a note that carries 4 tiles ahead of you in a narrow cone, dealing 4 resonating damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Heard, Then Loosed
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at the first enemy in its path up to 12 tiles away for 34 piercing damage. It is always a critical hit, and it leaves the target [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sounded Distance
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Found the Gaps
fusions.desc: Your piercing damage cannot be resisted.
